entries.detail: 36dd6b8 was reported as the Item 374 upload. It changes no file against b0bb24b; the live delivery-manifest.json still reads Item 373 (9 of 9 hashes matching), and no item374 record is in the repository. A commit is not a delivery; the manifest check is. This package carries Item 374 and the sixth checkbox together.

entries.what: The sixth checkbox, built under the Chair’s ruling
entries.detail: “State Who We Are one-pager” links poster2-<market>.html (the first poster the removed First-touch link carried); expansion pages use their base market. Proved additive on florida, arizona and chicago-expansion: unticked, the body is identical to the Item 374 body; ticked, it adds one line once; unticked again, the body returns exactly; with a hand edit, the edit survives tick and untick; it survives a tone change; Copy rich names it “Who we are in your state, on one page”. It routes through the CAN-SPAM gate: alone on a first touch it copies, and with a second link the gate refuses.
